verdict.rationale: There is evidence of MCP connectors/plugins being installable locally and skills/agents publishable to a marketplace via CLI (SKILL.md bundles, lhm CLI, market-cli), plus agent profile editing in Markdown, suggesting a plugin/skill ecosystem exists. However, there's no first-party documented schema/spec for writing a custom tool/plugin from scratch, no local-loading walkthrough for a self-authored plugin (only installing pre-existing marketplace ones), and no hands-on developer confirmation that self-written tools work locally. missing for 10: a documented plugin/tool schema or API reference for authoring from scratch, a concrete guide for loading a self-made (not marketplace) skill/tool locally, and independent developer corroboration of successfully building and loading a custom plugin.
